label: vs_rho claim smoke: one public target on a Koblitz curve
description: The shape a vs_rho claim needs: public targets (nobody knows the logarithm; the answer is checked by [d]G = Q), the strong single-target rho reference, the plain signed-Frobenius rho as the operations baseline, and an ic.pipeline candidate. Each workload is one target; ecbench claim build takes one IC run and one strong-rho run of it. Small enough for CI; a claim worth making uses a larger curve, more targets and the spec's L2.
